A standalone web reconstruction based on the original game data and analysis of Golden Axe for DOS. No emulator is used. Fidelity checks for mechanics and complete playthroughs are ongoing.

Painted HD graphics and remastered audio are the defaults. HD/original graphics can be switched during play. MUSIC or the Options/pause button selects the music edition; F3 toggles music on/off. The build commit is shown only from verified clean CI build metadata; a local working snapshot has no verified build commit.

Late Duel rounds: the boss color variant follows the current port; equivalence to the original DOS game has not been verified.
